title: Staylumen Blog for Short-Term Rental Owners
description: The Staylumen blog: practical guides for short-term rental owners on management, co-hosting, pricing, listings and the costs of running a rental.
heading: Staylumen Blog
intro: Guides for short-term rental owners weighing how to run, price and hand off a vacation rental.

blocks.heading: What You Will Find in These Guides
paragraphs: Our [online management team](/about-us/) writes these guides from the daily work of running owners' listings, pricing and guest messages remotely across the United States. Each one looks at a decision you face as an owner, from fees to agreements to tracking profit. For checklists, see our [free owner resources](/resources/); for contracts and payouts, our [owner FAQ](/faq/).

blocks.heading: Send Us an Enquiry & Work With Our Team
paragraphs: [Send us an enquiry](/contact-us/) to discuss working with our team on your short-term rental. We’ll reply within one business day.
